checks: Desktop city selection, slash shortcut and date flexibility work above the globe
Route suggestions update both airports and selection state without starting a search
Exposed globe is draggable, rotates automatically, holds rotation while grabbed, keeps route trails moving and coasts on release without selecting text
Submit uses the existing query and transitions to the compact results header; all search requests intercepted
Phone layout has no horizontal overflow, the full calendar fits, and flexibility and party controls work
Choosing a phone route suggestion brings the updated form back into view and focuses departure
